twoInstances: Both messaging and notification instances replay the same committed event to their connected device, through separate local gateways
messagingRestart: Bounded stream close; another instance serves commands and replays missed state
notificationRestart: Remaining consumer persists once; peer stream recovers from original cursor
gatewayRestart: Gateway closes streams; REST through peer commits; original URL replays after restart
databaseInterruption: Paused real Oracle closes stalled stream; readiness DOWN/503; committed history replays after unpause
